method: Direct original-resolution inspection of changed final iteration-75 page 5; pages 1--4 and 6--12 have byte-identical render hashes to iteration 73, when all twelve pages were directly inspected. Checked exact equation/figure/table/caption/pagination and bibliography rendering.
